requestString:
HTTPRequest(url=http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions, method=POST, headers={
  "baml-original-url": "http://localhost:11434/v1",
  "content-type": "application/json"
}, body={
  "model": "reap48-fixed:latest",
  "temperature": 0,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Return plain JSON only.
Schema:
Answer in JSON using this schema:
{
  reviewDecision: "finalize" or "revise",
  reviewReason: string,
  revisionInstruction: string or null,
  traceAlignment: "aligned" or "misaligned" or null,
  traceAlignmentReason: string or null,
  finalTemperament: {
    tightness: int or null,
    rationale: int or null,
    attribution: int or null,
    caution: int or null,
    extent: int or null,
  } or null,
  moduleHints: string[] or null,
  concerns: {
    length: "too_long" or "ok" or null,
    style: "too_stiff" or "ok" or null,
    evidence: "needs_caution" or "ok" or null,
  } or null,
  routingHints: string[] or null,
}
Choose \"finalize\" when the draft is complete, accurate, and ready.
Choose \"revise\" only when one additional revision would materially improve quality.
Provide concise fields and keep revisionInstruction specific and short.
Do not include markdown or extra keys.

Draft:
The draft is accurate.

Review context:
The draft is ready."
    }
  ]
})
